steps.label: 1. Place order
steps.description: The customer places an order on the web shop or by message.

steps.label: 2. In stock?
steps.description: Sales checks the available stock for every line of the order.

steps.label: 3. Confirm order
steps.description: Sales confirms the order and sends the pick instruction to the warehouse.

steps.label: 4. Pick and ship
steps.description: The warehouse picks, packs and ships the goods, then records the stock movement.

steps.label: 5. Issue invoice
steps.description: Finance issues the invoice once delivery is confirmed and posts it to the ledger.

steps.label: 6. Handle return
steps.description: A returned or damaged item is booked back into stock and the invoice is adjusted.

cards.title: How to read it
items: Each column is one role and time runs top to bottom
The description beside a row explains the step in that row
